items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: And he was another one that was slick. He always had his -- name was Lincoln Perry, I think.

ctx.x: And this is when he had his Lincoln?

Oh, yeah, that was Bechet, man. Bechet went and bought a new Lincoln (inaudible) yeah, I'm going to show you something. Said, if anybody bothers me, I'm going to show you what I'll do, and he pulled out a rifle. See, he reached up, he had a place built in that -- over the windshield, and pulled out a rifle. (Inaudible). Bechet! "No, if anybody -- if I don't see them from that angle, I'll get them from this angle." Reached down where his hand brake was and pulled out a carbine.
